title: Full-Resolution Network and Dual-Threshold Iteration for Retinal Vessel and Coronary Angiograph Segmentation
mechanism: Keeps a full-resolution stream so 1 px structures never pass through a stride. Dual-threshold iteration (DTI) then grows low-confidence pixels that connect to high-confidence ones, a hysteresis step.
adaptation: Two arms. (a) DTI needs no training: apply hysteresis growth (high seed threshold, low growth threshold, 8-connected) to the existing 5-seed ensemble crack probabilities, with thresholds chosen on val and F51. (b) smp U-Net++ drops the full-resolution feature (its finest skip is conv1 at 1/2). Add a 3-layer stride-1 conv branch (32 ch) on the 1-channel input and concatenate it into the last decoder block.
min_experiment: (a) DTI on house ensemble outputs vs the same ensemble at argmax and with the val-chosen logit bias. Metric: test-clean crack relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90, plus E1 recall. Kill if the relR@2 gain is < 0.01 at matched relP@2. (b) Detail branch vs house, 5 v 5 seeds. Kill if crack IoU gains < 0.012 and relF1@2 gains < 0.01.
evidence: R: the abstract reports the best Sen, AUC, F1 and IoU on most of DRIVE (20 train images), CHASE_DB1, STARE, DCA1 and CHUAC, with fewer parameters, and says DTI greatly improves sensitivity and connectivity. Ablation numbers not retrieved.
prior_overlap: Partial. A val-chosen logit bias (a global threshold) was run in section 5. A connectivity-conditional threshold was not, and no full-resolution branch was ever tried.

alt_notes.adaptation: DTI as pure post-processing on saved crack probabilities of the house and PF ensembles (t_high, t_low chosen on val). FR-UNet trained from scratch on 1-ch 512 px cells, 24 classes, as a heterogeneous ensemble member.
alt_notes.min_experiment: A (0 GPU-h): DTI on 5-seed house and PF ensemble logits vs current val-chosen logit-bias operating point; metric test relR@2 at matched relP@2, components >=20 px found. Kill: relR@2 gain < 0.01 at equal relP@2. B: FR-UNet 5 seeds vs house 5 seeds; kill if single model crack relF1@2 < house - 0.02 and adding it to the ensemble does not raise ensemble relF1@2.
